title: List Narrowing Funnel
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Run Marcus's 18-college long list through three narrowing passes (fit, balance, and picturing yourself there) and watch each cut get logged with its reason.

learningObjectives: Students will judge which colleges to cut from a long list at each narrowing pass and justify each cut using fit criteria and list balance.
prerequisites: Chapter 4: Researching and Narrowing Your College List

controls: Run Pass 1, 2, and 3 buttons (Finish Pass in manual mode)

keyQuestions: Why does the balance pass come after the fit pass and not before?
Is "I can't say why I want it" a good reason to cut a college? Why?
What would you do if Pass 2 left you with only one safety?
commonMisconceptions: The final list should keep the most prestigious names.
Cutting is only about admission chances, not fit or cost.
assessmentOpportunities: Students narrow the long list to a final list that passes every balance check and justify each cut with a fit criterion or a balance reason.
